title: Hermes hardening registry
description: Registry of atomic hardening controls and composable deployment profiles with a deterministic applicability evaluator. Controls FMR-001 through FMR-014 and all test inventories are synthetic seed examples: generic and original, with illustrative placeholder dates and examples that are not claims about any specific Hermes release or incident. Controls from FMR-015 onward are operational-practice synthesis: generalised from recorded operational practice with all private detail removed (provenance.origin: synthesis); they describe practice, not publicly verifiable incidents. Every version range carries an explicit evidence basis: exercised, documentation or illustrative. Seed ranges are illustrative placeholders and synthesis ranges are documentation reviews, so a report never implies exercised platform compatibility unless a range says so itself.
